name: paper_resolver_skill
description: Resolve a paper identifier (arxiv/doi/openreview/local) to S2 metadata + optional PDF text, or run a Semantic Scholar keyword search. Single skill, two modes: 'resolve' for one known paper, 'search' for keyword lookup. Shared per-paper mapping helper; only URL + envelope-unwrap differ between modes. Never raises — every exit returns a {status, data, message} envelope.

mode.description: Skill dispatch mode. 'resolve' fetches one paper by identifier; 'search' runs an S2 keyword query and returns a list of matched papers (metadata-only by default — no per-result PDF fetch).

source_type.description: Resolve-mode only: identifier scheme. Ignored when mode='search'.

identifier.description: Resolve-mode only: arXiv ID (e.g. '2406.04378'), DOI, OpenReview URL, or repo-relative path. Ignored when mode='search'.

verbosity.description: Depth of resolution. 0 = S2 metadata only (no PDF). 1 = metadata + extracted text snippet (later compressed to PaperExtract by the lit-review node). 2 = full extracted text. Resolve-mode default 1; search-mode default 0 (fan-out cost trap otherwise).

query.description: Search-mode only: keyword query string. Ignored when mode='resolve'.

limit.description: Search-mode only: maximum results to return. Default 10, hard-capped at 50.

year.description: Search-mode optional filter: publication-year filter as accepted by the S2 search endpoint (e.g. '2020', '2019-2023', '2018-').

fields_of_study.description: Search-mode optional filter: comma-separated S2 fieldsOfStudy values (e.g. 'Computer Science,Physics').

publication_types.description: Search-mode optional filter: comma-separated S2 publicationTypes values (e.g. 'JournalArticle,Conference').

min_citation_count.description: Search-mode optional filter: minimum citation count, mapped to the S2 minCitationCount query param.
